summary: Both editions were independently reviewed against every clause of the selected Greek. No concrete fidelity defect was identified. Both preserve the full portrait, the message’s effects and renewal comparison, singular and plural spirits, the four-footed seat and four-element explanation, both repentance expressions and their emphasis, definite future newness and foundation, complete revelation, the prohibition’s scope, and the conditional necessity and definite promise. The simplified edition’s sentence divisions retain these relationships. Disclosed lexical choices remain source-compatible; the supplied witness reports support the notes’ distinctions among preserved wording, corrections, editorial restorations, and spacing conjectures without requiring replacement of the working reading. Acceptance is limited to this supplied material and does not authenticate unseen images, certify editions or handwriting, or claim exhaustive collation or a unique interpretation.
